what: In the black pill floating at the bottom of the screen (a few links + a round menu button), pressing the button makes a same-size plate behind the pill grow in .35s to drawer size while holding its bottom-left corner (38px corners · shifted slightly toward the bottom left). The pill links fade out right away, and the drawer links light up one by one every .05s starting at .45s. The button shrinks to .875x, its background inverts, and its three lines turn into an X. On close, the drawer links go off first, the plate shrinks .3s later, and the pill links return .6s later. On hover, the button’s middle and bottom lines shrink to .92 and .8

options.[data-fx-part=pill]: Pill (child) — holds the link and the panel. The panel’s closed size is measured from the pill size
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Link inside the pill — fades when opened
options.[data-fx-part=panel] > [data-fx-part=inn: Inner plate behind the pill that changes size
options.[data-fx-part=link]: Drawer links — light up in turn
options.w · h · pad: Open inner leaf width, height and inner padding (css lengths), default 402px · 551px · 79px 0 (from 27.951vw · 38.252vw · 5.498vw at the original 1440 width)
options.shift: Distance it shifts left and down when opened, default 13px (.926vw)
options.dur · close · back: Length .35 · panel close delay .3 · pill link return delay .6 (seconds) — shorten for places opened often, like apps
options.link-delay · lag: Drawer links first turn on at .45 · stagger .05 (sec)
options.fx:open · fx:close: Event the element fires on open and close

use:
Home…

note: The position (fixed at the bottom center of the screen) is decided by the consuming side. Hiding it when the bottom is visible is left to another part such as dock-reveal or the consuming side’s css
